 Robbie Avila Nears Contract for New Landing Spot in Latest Rumors After Lakers Stint, SLU Transfer
 Joseph Zucker Nov 12, 2026 Former Saint Louis center Robbie Avila is "finalizing" a move to TCU and should arrive on the campus this week, according to ESPN's Pete Thamel .
 A judge granted Avila a preliminary injunction to play this season. After a four-year college career that began at Indiana State, he joined the Los Angeles Lakers as an undrafted free agent. He played for L.A. in the NBA Summer League but didn't sign a full pro contract.
 A return to Saint Louis became complicated by the College Sports Commission declaring the Billikens couldn't have an extra spot to accommodate the 6'10" big man. As a result, he had to explore his options elsewhere.

 Bleacher Report 1d Avila was the Atlantic 10 Player of the Year in 2025-26, and he was a productive frontcourt presence for both Indiana State and Saint Louis. He's averaging 14.5 points, 5.5 rebounds and 0.6 blocks for his career.
 TCU is already three games into its season, though. It can be difficult enough for an incoming transfer to find a comfort zone when they've had a full offseason to train and practice. Avila has to adapt totally on the fly.
 The Horned Frogs can't make an addition of this caliber otherwise, so it's easy to see why they'd bring Avila to Fort Worth. They could use some size as well. They have six players averaging double figures in scoring, and none is taller than 6'9".
 Fans may nonetheless want to temper expectations because there's a chance Avila is unable to have the kind of impact he did with his last two schools.
